summary: Eren is taken to the Survey Corps' old castle. Levi's squad does not trust him, and Hange introduces two captured Titans as the start of an experiment.

segments.ja: 調査兵団がエレンを連れて行った先は、壁の内側なのに森に近い古い城でした。特別作戦班の本部です。廊下は細く、朝の光は地下まで届きません。リヴァイは規則だけを置いて、歓迎の言葉は置きません。ここで食事をし、ここで寝て、命令なしに巨人になるな。エレンは鎖を外されても、自由になった感じがしませんでした。所属が変わっただけで、見られている密度は増しています。
segments.en: The Survey Corps took Eren to an old castle near the woods, still inside the walls. It was the headquarters of the Special Operations Squad. The halls were narrow, and morning light did not reach the basement. Levi set down rules and did not set down a welcome. Eat here. Sleep here. Do not become a Titan without an order. Even with the chains off, Eren did not feel free. Only his regiment had changed. The density of being watched had increased.

segments.ja: ペトラ、オルオ、エルド、グンター。リヴァイ班の四人は、新兵のエレンに笑顔を少しだけ見せ、その下に刃の準備を隠していません。ペトラは作法を教え、オルオは自分の経験を大げさに語り、エルドは場をまとめ、グンターは距離を測ります。どの顔も、昨日の審議を知っています。暴走したら殺す、という条件は、この城では日常の配置図でした。エレンはお茶を出す手を、必要以上にゆっくり動かします。
segments.en: Petra, Oluo, Eld, Gunther. The four of Levi's squad showed the new recruit a little politeness and did not hide the blades under it. Petra taught him the manners of the room. Oluo inflated his own experience. Eld kept the peace. Gunther measured distance. Every face knew about yesterday's hearing. The condition that he would be killed if he lost control was, in this castle, an ordinary diagram of where people stood. Eren moved his hands too slowly when he poured tea.

segments.ja: 空気を変えたのはハンジ・ゾエです。調査兵団の分隊長で、巨人の話になると声の温度が上がります。ハンジはエレンを恐れより先に質問で見ます。変身に痛みはあるか、意識はどこへ行くか、何をきっかけに体が巨人を作るのか。エレンは答えの半分も持っていません。ハンジはそれでも目を輝かせます。未知は、この人にとっては脅威である前に実験の入口でした。リヴァイはその熱を、短いため息で受け流します。
segments.en: Hange Zoe changed the air. A squad leader in the Survey Corps, and the temperature of their voice rose whenever Titans were the subject. Hange looked at Eren with questions before fear. Did transformation hurt. Where did his mind go. What triggered the body to build a Titan. Eren did not have half the answers. Hange's eyes shone anyway. For this person, the unknown was a door into an experiment before it was a threat. Levi let that heat pass with a short sigh.

segments.ja: 城の外、日光を避けた場所に、捕獲された巨人が二体いました。ハンジは彼らにソニーとビーンという名前をつけています。話すためではありません。観察するためです。光に出すと動きが変わるか、言葉に反応するか、食事の欲求はどれだけ続くか。兵たちは名前を笑う人もいます。ハンジは笑いを無視して、記録を取ります。エレンは格子の向こうの巨人を見て、自分の体の記憶が熱くなるのを隠しました。
segments.en: Outside the castle, in a place kept out of the sunlight, there were two captured Titans. Hange had named them Sawney and Bean. Not so they could talk. So they could be observed. Did movement change in the light. Did they react to words. How long did the desire to eat continue. Some soldiers laughed at the names. Hange ignored the laughter and kept notes. Eren looked at the Titans beyond the bars and hid the way his own body remembered heat.

segments.ja: ハンジの計画は、ソニーとビーンで得た問いを、次にエレンへ向けることでした。ただし順番があります。まず安全な条件を作り、次に変身を試し、失敗したらすぐに討伐できる位置に班を置く。エレンは実験台であると同時に、新兵としてその配置を見せられました。自分を殺す角度を、同僚の口から聞く経験は、訓練兵団にはありません。ペトラはあとで、これは敵意ではない、と小さく補足します。補足は親切で、配置そのものは変わりません。
segments.en: Hange's plan was to turn the questions learned from Sawney and Bean toward Eren next. There was an order. First make the conditions safe. Then try a transformation. If it failed, the squad would already be standing where they could kill him. Eren was shown that arrangement both as a test subject and as a recruit. The Training Corps had never asked him to hear, from a colleague's mouth, the angle from which he would be killed. Later Petra added, quietly, that this was not hostility. The addition was kind. The arrangement did not change.

segments.en: At night, in the castle basement, Eren listened to Erwin. The Commander said the Survey Corps did not ride outside the walls only to kill Titans. Humanity was living without knowing what it was. People died to shrink that ignorance. Eren's power might be a tool that could open a hole in it. Erwin did not hand over his expectation as encouragement. He handed it over as the description of a heavy tool. Eren could only nod. The word basement overlapped, in his head, with his father's dream and this stone room.

segments.en: Hange talked about the notes on Sawney and Bean even at the table. Block the sunlight and activity drops. Words get little response. Even when they show pain, there is no back-and-forth of will like a human's. Then why did Eren come back when his name was called. Hange did not rush a conclusion. Not enough data, they said, and looked pleased. Some of the squad winced. Eren felt both resistance and relief that the reason his mind returned was being turned into an item in an experiment.

segments.ja: 明日、エレンは城の外で変身を試します。成功すれば、調査兵団は奪還の鍵を一つ手にします。失敗すれば、特別作戦班は新兵を討伐する班に戻ります。ペトラは寝る前に、怖がっていい、とだけ言いました。オルオはそれを弱い言葉だと言い、自分も同じことを小さい声で繰り返します。リヴァイは廊下の端で、刃の位置だけを確認していました。エレンは天井を見たまま、巨人になりたい欲求と、人間でいたい欲求が、同じ胸で喧嘩するのを聞いています。
segments.en: Tomorrow, outside the castle, Eren would try to transform. If he succeeded, the Survey Corps would hold one key to retaking land. segments.ja: ペトラはエレンに、変身の記憶を文章にするよう勧めます。上手な文である必要はない、抜けているところを空欄にしろ、と。エレンは痛み、熱、アルミンの声、岩の重さ、そして途中が白いことを書きます。白い部分を隠そうとすると、ペトラは空欄のままでいいと言います。特別作戦班は、英雄の完全な物語ではなく、欠落のある記録を必要としていました。エレンはその欠落を、自分の欠陥としてではなく、データとして置けることに驚きます。
segments.en: Petra urged Eren to turn the memory of transformation into sentences. They did not have to be good sentences. Leave a blank where something was missing. He wrote pain, heat, Armin's voice, the weight of the boulder, and the fact that the middle was white. When he tried to hide the white part, Petra said the blank could stay. The Special Operations Squad needed a record with gaps, not a hero's complete story. Eren was surprised that he could set the gap down as data, not only as a defect in himself.

segments.ja: リヴァイのもう一つの規則は、城を汚さないことでした。血と泥の遠征の合間に、床のほこりを許さない。エレンは最初、その細かさを馬鹿にします。ペトラは、細かい人ほど戦場で仲間の位置を見落とさない、と説明します。説明がどこまで本当かは分かりません。それでも布を持つリヴァイは、広間で暴力を振るった人と同じ手です。エレンはその手を、制御の別の形として見始めます。殺す手と、拭く手を同じ人が持っている。
segments.en: Levi's other rule was not to let the castle get dirty. Between expeditions of blood and mud, he did not allow dust on the floor. At first Eren thought the fussiness was ridiculous. Petra explained that a fussy person was less likely to miss where a comrade stood in a battle. He did not know how true that was. Even so, Levi holding a cloth had the same hands as the person who had used violence in the hall. Eren started to see those hands as another shape of control. The same person held the hand that kills and the hand that wipes.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉です。特別作戦班は、リヴァイが率いる小さい班で、エレンを守り、必要なら殺します。兵長はリヴァイの階級です。実験は、ハンジがソニーとビーンに行い、次にエレンへ向ける試しです。捕獲は、巨人を殺さずに確保することです。討伐は、殺す任務です。新兵は、この城ではエレン自身を指します。団長エルヴィンは、その実験の先に壁の外の無知を見ています。半円の中で、エレンはまだ変身していません。
segments.en: Today's words. The Special Operations Squad is Levi's small squad. It protects Eren and, if needed, kills him. Captain is Levi's rank. An experiment is what Hange does with Sawney and Bean, and next intends to try on Eren. Capture means securing a Titan without killing it. A slaying mission means the opposite. Recruit, in this castle, points at Eren himself. Commander Erwin looks past the experiment at the ignorance outside the walls. Inside the half circle, Eren has not transformed yet.

vocab.exampleEn: The Survey Corps took Eren to an old castle near the woods, still inside the walls. It was the headquarters of the Special Operations Squad. The halls were narrow, and morning light did not reach the basement. Levi set down rules and did not set down a welcome. Eat here. Sleep here. Do not become a Titan without an order. Even with the chains off, Eren did not feel free. Only his regiment had changed. The density of being watched had increased.

vocab.exampleEn: Hange Zoe changed the air. A squad leader in the Survey Corps, and the temperature of their voice rose whenever Titans were the subject. Hange looked at Eren with questions before fear. Did transformation hurt. Where did his mind go. What triggered the body to build a Titan. Eren did not have half the answers. Hange's eyes shone anyway. For this person, the unknown was a door into an experiment before it was a threat. Levi let that heat pass with a short sigh.
